description: Fixtures for the v3 SDK HTTP/error path. Each case is a malformed error envelope: a response body that does NOT satisfy the { code: number, message: string, request_id: string, data?: object } contract. The v3 transport (src/v3/http.ts, V3HttpTransport.request) MUST normalize every case to a thrown TDAMError (never a raw TypeError / uncaught parse error).

cases.name: json_null_body
cases.malformation: body parses to null instead of an envelope object

expect.name: TDAMError
expect.message: API response must be a JSON object

cases.name: json_array_body
cases.malformation: body parses to an array instead of an envelope object

expect.name: TDAMError
expect.message: API response must be a JSON object

cases.name: non_json_error_body
cases.malformation: error response whose body is not JSON at all

cases.name: string_code_error
cases.malformation: code is a non-numeric string, so no numeric business code is available

cases.name: missing_code_and_message
cases.malformation: envelope has neither code nor message; only request_id survives
